title: RDP: auto-reconnect kicks in after deliberate logoff when 'Reconnect on disconnect' is enabled
author: robertpopa22
body_snippet:
## Summary

With **Options → Advanced → "Automatically try to reconnect when disconnected"** (`ReconnectOnDisconnect`) enabled, deliberately logging off inside an RDP session does not close the session — mRemoteNG shows the reconnect panel and the reconnect timer logs the user straight back in (or parks at the logon screen and retries).

Found while analyzing #139 (independent model review of the RDP disconnect path).
